Preference.app:title: What gets sent
Preference.app:summary:
Sharing is opt-in and off until you switch it on. Only events logged after you switch it on are sent, about every 6 hours (on Wi-Fi only unless you change that).

For each word the keyboard corrected: the word as you typed it, where your finger touched each key, up to 120 characters of text before it (and the next few words for to/too-style fixes), the suggestions it considered, what it picked and whether you kept it, plus the style, model and app version. For words it left alone: only timing numbers, no text.

Nothing typed in password, incognito, email, web address, number, phone or date fields is ever recorded, so it can never be sent.

Uploads carry a random ID made by this app, not your name, account or phone ID. The server doesn’t store IP addresses. It’s used only to improve this autocorrect.
